checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Block builder MUST NOT circumvent gas cap via direct block construction
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all code paths where blocks can be constructed (SG-002 block-level validation). 2. Trace the block building flow to determine if transactions can bypass txpool validation. 3. Verify that block validation (SG-002) independently re-checks gasLimit for EVERY transaction regardless of source (txpool vs direct inclusion). 4. Attempt to construct a block with transactions exceeding gas cap that were NOT validated by txpool. 5. Confirm block validation rejects blocks containing transactions with invalid gasLimit. 6. Check for any code paths that trust transaction validity based on source rather than re-validating.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0016, Trust Boundary: tb-005, Primary Element: SG-002. Critical boundary check - block builders (actor-block-builder) could potentially include invalid transactions if block validation does not independently verify gas limits.

checklist.title: Verify block-builder cannot inject transactions with excessive gasLimit via P2P block propagation
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the P2P block reception handler to identify how incoming blocks are validated. 2. Trace whether transaction gasLimit is checked during block import from P2P. 3. Create a test block with transactions having gasLimit > block gas cap. 4. Submit the malformed block via P2P network interface. 5. Verify the block is rejected and not processed into the chain. 6. Check error handling - ensure rejection is logged and peer is penalized if appropriate.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0016, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Supporting check for P2P entry point - validates that blocks received from untrusted peers undergo proper gas validation.

checklist.title: Verify block validator (actor-block-validator) enforces independent gas validation on all transaction sources
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the block validator component (actor-block-validator) in the codebase. 2. Identify all functions that validate transactions within a block. 3. Verify gasLimit validation is performed unconditionally (not skipped based on transaction source). 4. Check for any caching or optimization that might skip re-validation of previously validated transactions. 5. Review code for assumptions like 'if tx came from txpool, it must be valid'. 6. Create unit tests that attempt to import blocks with mixed valid/invalid gasLimit transactions.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0016, Node: actor-block-validator. Supporting node check - ensures the validator does not implicitly trust transactions from any source.

checklist.title: Verify block builder (actor-block-builder) cannot bypass txpool validation when constructing blocks locally
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the block builder component (actor-block-builder) in the codebase. 2. Identify all interfaces through which transactions can be added to a block being built. 3. Check if block builder can directly include transactions without txpool validation. 4. If direct inclusion is possible, verify block-level validation (SG-002) catches invalid transactions. 5. Review miner/sequencer configuration for any 'trusted transaction' features that skip validation. 6. Test block building with a transaction that would fail txpool validation but might slip through direct inclusion.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0016, Node: actor-block-builder. Supporting node check - ensures block construction enforces gas limits regardless of how transactions are sourced.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is gasLimit re-validated during EIP-1559 transaction replacement (fee bumping)?
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the transaction replacement code path handling EIP-1559 fee bumping in the txpool. 2. Locate where gasLimit validation occurs for replacement transactions. 3. Verify that the gasLimit cap (16777216) is enforced on replacement transactions, not just original submissions. 4. Attempt to submit a valid transaction with gasLimit <= 16777216, then replace it with a transaction having gasLimit > 16777216. 5. Confirm the replacement is rejected with appropriate error. 6. Check for any code paths that might skip validation during replacement (e.g., assuming original was valid implies replacement is valid).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0017, Trust Boundary: tb-001, Primary Element: SG-001. This is a transaction replacement bypass vulnerability. The attack vector is submitting a valid transaction first, then using the replacement mechanism to sneak in an oversized gasLimit that would have been rejected on initial submission.

checklist.title: Verify gasLimit cap enforcement is consistent between initial transaction submission and replacement paths
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Trace the transaction validation flow for initial submission and identify gasLimit checks. 2. Trace the transaction replacement flow (fee bumping) and identify if the same gasLimit checks are applied. 3. Compare both code paths to ensure identical validation logic is used. 4. Look for any early-exit conditions or optimizations that might skip validation on replacement (e.g., 'only validate fee fields changed'). 5. Review test coverage to ensure replacement path validation is explicitly tested. 6. Check for race conditions where a replacement could be processed before validation completes.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0017, Supporting check for tb-001. Validates that validation logic is not bypassed through the replacement mechanism. The txpool (actor-txpool) must enforce limits regardless of whether transaction is new or a replacement.

checklist.title: Verify txpool (actor-txpool) treats replacement transactions as untrusted input requiring full validation
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the txpool component (actor-txpool) in the codebase. 2. Identify the replacement transaction handler (typically triggered when nonce matches existing pending tx). 3. Verify that replacement transactions go through the same validation pipeline as new transactions. 4. Check for any trust assumptions like 'replacement only changes fee, so gasLimit must be same'. 5. Review if there's differential validation based on transaction type (legacy vs EIP-1559). 6. Test with various replacement scenarios: same gasLimit, lower gasLimit, higher gasLimit (up to and exceeding cap).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0017, Node: actor-txpool. Supporting node check - ensures the txpool does not implicitly trust replacement transactions based on the validity of the original.
